project.name: Ultimate Gym System
project.description: A full-stack fitness platform with role-based access (admin, coach, client), real-time chat, AI coaching, workout management, courses, tips, analytics, and notifications.

communication.rest_api: HTTP REST via axios (web) / http package (Flutter)
communication.realtime: Socket.IO for chat, notifications, typing indicators
communication.auth: JWT access + refresh tokens stored in localStorage / secure storage

models.User: roles: admin|coach|client; fields: name, email, password, role, avatar, isApproved, isActive, refreshToken, googleId, appleId
models.WorkoutPlan: title, description, coach (ref User), assignedTo (ref User), category, difficulty, status, exercises[], isTemplate
models.Course: title, description, instructor (ref User), level, category, price, content.weeks[].materials[], enrollmentCount, averageRating, totalRatings, prerequisites[], tags[], thumbnail, isPublished
models.Tip: title, content, author (ref User), category, type (article|video|workout), difficulty, media[], tags[], likes[], bookmarks[], comments[], views, estimatedTime, isPublished
models.Exercise: name, description, category, muscleGroup, difficulty, instructions, mediaUrl
models.Progress: user (ref User), date, type (workout|body), notes, photos[], bodyStats{}
models.Notification: recipient, sender, type, title, message, isRead, readAt, category, priority, actionUrl, data
models.Conversation: isGroup, groupName, groupPhoto, members[], lastMessage, lastMessageText, lastMessageSender, unreadCounts[]
models.Message: conversationId, sender (ref User), content, messageType (text|image|video|file), attachments[], isRead, readAt
models.AiUserProfile: user (ref User), fitnessGoals, currentFitnessLevel, healthConditions[], preferredWorkouts[]

routes./api/auth: POST /login, POST /register, POST /refresh, POST /logout, GET /me, POST /google, POST /apple
routes./api/users: GET / (list+filter), GET /:id, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, PUT /:id/approve, GET /coaches
routes./api/workouts: GET /, POST /, GET /:id, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/assign, POST /request-plan
routes./api/courses: GET /, POST /, GET /:id, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/enroll, PUT /:id/progress, GET /my-courses, GET /my-progress, PUT /:id/publish, POST /:id/thumbnail
routes./api/tips: GET /, POST /, GET /:id, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/like, POST /:id/bookmark, GET /:id/comments, POST /:id/comments, POST /:id/media, PUT /:id/publish
routes./api/chat: POST /conversation/create-direct, POST /conversation/create-group, GET /conversation/list, GET /conversation/:id/messages, PUT /conversation/:id/mark-read, PUT /conversation/:id/mute, DELETE /conversation/:id

middleware.auth: JWT verification, role guards: adminOnly, coachOnly, clientOnly, isApproved
middleware.validation: express-validator per route, Joi schemas for complex payloads

backend.cron: node-cron for reminder notifications and scheduled tasks

web.api_client: axios with request interceptor (Bearer token) + response interceptor (auto-refresh on 401, queue failed requests)
web.realtime: socket.io-client 4.8 — singleton socket at module level
web.routing: Next.js App Router (file-based, server + client components)

app_routes./: Root redirect based on auth state
app_routes./auth/login: Login page (email/password) — dispatches login thunk, uses unwrap() + role-based redirect
app_routes./auth/register: Register page — role selection (client|coach), same pattern
app_routes./client/plan: Request plan from coach + view assigned plans
app_routes./client/courses/[id]: Course detail (overview, content, progress, reviews tabs)

authSlice.state: { token, user: UserProfile|null, role: admin|coach|client|null, loading, error }

workoutsSlice.state: { plans: WorkoutPlan[], loading, error, pagination, requestLoading, requestSent, requestError }

coursesSlice.state: { courses: Course[], currentCourse, enrolledCourses: CourseEnrollment[], loading, error, pagination }
coursesSlice.thunks: fetchCourses, fetchCourseById, enrollInCourse, updateProgress, fetchMyCourses, fetchMyProgress, clearCurrentCourse

tipsSlice.state: { tips: Tip[], currentTip, loading, error, pagination }
tipsSlice.thunks: fetchTips, fetchTipById, likeTip, bookmarkTip, fetchTipComments, addTipComment, clearCurrentTip

chatSlice.state: { conversations: Conversation[], currentConversation, messages: Message[], typingUsers, loading, error, unreadCount, hasMore, currentPage }
chatSlice.thunks: fetchConversations({}), fetchMessages, createDirectConversation, createGroupConversation, markConversationAsRead, leaveConversation
chatSlice.reducers: addMessage, receiveMessage, setCurrentConversation, clearCurrentConversation, addTypingUser, removeTypingUser, markMessageAsRead, resetChat

analyticsSlice.state: { users{}, courses{}, tips{}, workouts{}, revenue{} } — each: { data: AnalyticsData|null, loading, error }

services.api.ts: axios instance, base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, Bearer token interceptor, 401 auto-refresh with queue
services.courseService.ts: getCourses(filters), getCourseById, createCourse, updateCourse, enrollInCourse, updateCourseProgress, getMyCourses, getMyProgress, publishCourse, uploadCourseThumbnail
services.tipService.ts: getTips(filters), getTipById, createTip, updateTip, likeTip, bookmarkTip, getTipComments, addTipComment, publishTip, uploadTipMedia

key_components.AppShell: Layout shell — Sidebar + header (dark mode toggle, logout, NotificationBell). Dark mode uses lazy useState initializer from localStorage.
key_components.Sidebar: Role-based nav links; collapses on mobile
key_components.ProtectedRoute: Checks auth.token + role against allowedRoles; redirects to /auth/login if unauth
key_components.NotificationBell: Polls/subscribes for notifications; shows unread badge
key_components.CourseCard: Course listing card with enrollment status indicator
key_components.FileUpload: Wraps axios multipart POST to Cloudinary endpoint; exposes onUpload(url) callback

hooks.useSocket: Singleton Socket.IO connection. Token from localStorage. Returns { socket: Socket|null, isConnected }. Socket is module-level variable (not ref) to survive unmounts.
hooks.useChat(conversationId?): Joins/leaves conversation room. Listens for new messages, typing, read events. Returns { messages, typingUsers, isConnected, sendConversationMessage, emitTypingStart, markAsRead, sendMessage, emitDirectTyping }

important_patterns.useRef: Always initialized: useRef<T | undefined>(undefined) — React 19 removed no-arg useRef
important_patterns.thunk_dispatch: Thunks with default object params require explicit arg: dispatch(fetchConversations({}))
important_patterns.error_handling: catch (e: unknown) — typeof e === 'string' for RTK rejectWithValue, instanceof Error for native errors
important_patterns.auth_redirect: dispatch(login(creds)).unwrap() then check result.user.role for routing
important_patterns.immer_narrowing: state.currentTip && state.currentTip._id === id (not state.currentTip?._id — optional chaining doesn't narrow)

mobile.api_client: http package via NetworkProvider (adds Bearer token header)
mobile.biometric: biometric_service.dart — local_auth package for fingerprint/Face ID

screens.client/: Dashboard, Workout viewer, Course viewer, Tips browser, Progress tracker, Chat

providers.auth_provider.dart: login, register, logout, refresh token, isAuthenticated
providers.network_provider.dart: base HTTP client with auth headers + error handling
providers.anatomy_provider.dart: muscle anatomy visualization data (not in web)

payment.note: price field exists, processing not implemented

api_conventions.pagination_response: { items: [], pagination: { page, limit, total, pages } }
api_conventions.uploads: multipart/form-data POST to /api/upload or specific resource endpoint

development.start_backend: cd backend && npm run dev  (nodemon, port 5000)
development.start_web: cd web && npm run dev  (Next.js, port 3000)

react_19_notes: React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLFormElement> replaces deprecated FormEvent in some contexts
Components defined inside render functions lose state — define at module level
rtk_notes: Thunks with default-valued object params still need {} at call site
Do not annotate .rejected handlers with PayloadAction — use action.payload as string
Immer optional chaining (?.) does not narrow type — use && for control flow
